messages.en: I'm watching SpongeBob right now.
It's been a while since I watched it.
Is this really rated for all ages???
Squidward's face is on fire,
and his neck keeps getting chopped off and stuff.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Grilled squid.
I was thinking that while watching...
Right, I was supposed to do a ceremonial first pitch,
but it got canceled because of the heat wave. ㅠㅠ
Last time I did the ceremonial hit,
so I was like, 'Please invite me for a first pitch too~'
and then it actually happened,
so I was really happy.
But after seeing the weather, I totally understood.
When I went outside,
the air felt so heavy,
and I could barely breathe.
Last time when I did the ceremonial hit,
I hit so badly that it became a meme.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ Before the first pitch got canceled,
my mom said,
'This time when you throw the first pitch,
try lifting the other leg.'
She actually said that. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 김채원은 나보고 팔을 계속 돌리다가 던지라고 하고
messages.en: ChaeWon told me to keep rotating my arm and then throw.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Should I do a flip before throwing it?
I was completely prepared,
so it's a shame it got canceled.
It's probably even sadder because you couldn't eat the famous Jamsil food.
That's honestly the biggest part.
I was planning to watch baseball while eating kimchi noodle soup properly.
I really was!!!
Heat wave, go away.
Nobody asked for me, but I came back again.
I'm really into Spider-Man right now,
so I want to buy a Spider-Man suit.
I need to buy that too.
The web-shooting gadget.
Apparently it actually exists.
I'm going to wear the suit, go to the movie theater,
and hang from the ceiling.
I think you'd end up on the 9 o'clock news.
'Due to the Spider-Man craze, a nuisance woman has appeared at a movie theater.'
Like that?

messages.ko: 와 지금 옆에는 징징이 또 불타고있네
messages.en: Wow, Squidward is on fire again on the screen.
Oh right.
I heard the Krabby Patty owner is a psycho.
You mean Mr. Krabs.
Yeah, that guy.
So apparently,
the reason the Krabby Patty recipe is secret is because
the Krusty Krab itself looks like a crab trap,
and they lure crabs in, kill them,
and make burgers out of them.

messages.ko: 그리고 본인이 게인데 게버거룰 만드는거 부터가 너무 잔잉행
messages.en: And the fact that he's a crab making crab burgers is so cruel.
Maybe he makes them from his own flesh.
Then he should already be dead.
There'd be no meat left inside him.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
Oh, true.
Anyone under 15,
pretend you didn't hear that.
I think I need to sleep with my mom tonight.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋ
Lately I really want brown hair.
When I look at old videos and photos,
I think it looks so pretty.
Or black hair.
Blonde is only pretty right when you first dye it.
I get tired of it after a while.
And the color keeps fading.

messages.ko: 근데 이왕 뺀거 여러색 해봐야하나 싶기도 하고
messages.en: But since I already bleached it, maybe I should try a bunch of colors.
I don't know. ㅠ
SpongeBob,
what are you doing right now!
That wasn't me. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
That was Sandy's voice.
They're saying, 'Wow, that's good.' ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅇㅋㅇㅋㄹ
Yeah, this one was me.
Voice impression.
Your voice got a lot deeper...
I've been practicing voice impressions a lot~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋ
Earlier I ate samgyeopsal with bibimmyeon.
Wait, where's mine?;;
It's being stored in my stomach.
Take it to go.

messages.ko: 하연이 냉장고에 모으는 배달 김치 가져가야겠다
messages.en: I should go take some of the delivery kimchi you've been collecting in your fridge.
Absolutely not!!!!!
I ordered an extra kimchi again this time,
but they sent two tiny sauce cups, so I was so disappointed.
Is kimchi your emergency food or something..?
But seriously,
when I get hungry late at night and it's awkward to order food,
I just take out kimchi and eat it.

messages.ko: 근데 김치를 그냥 시켜먹어도 되지 않어..?
messages.en: But couldn't you just order kimchi by itself..?
Then I wouldn't get to experience the different flavors of kimchi from each restaurant.
Which restaurant had the best kimchi?
Gukbap restaurant kimchi is the best.
If the kimchi is good, the restaurant is a good restaurant.
Exactly, that's what I'm saying.
And recently,
I got YeonJi into
Ansungtangmyun with three eggs too.
She tried it and finished every drop of the broth.
And that was after we'd already eaten sashimi.
That's how good it is.
Try it!!!
I'm telling you, try it!!!!
Wouldn't three eggs make it taste bland?
Not at all.

messages.ko: 근데 계란 넣으면 라면맛들 다 비슷해지는 느낌임
messages.en: I feel like adding eggs makes all ramens taste kind of similar.
Absolutely not.
YeonJi trusts my taste now
because I taught her how to enjoy seafood
and things like that.
She believes my food recommendations now.
'You trust unnie, right?'
Then she'll say,
'I do trust you~'
like that.
The other day when I went to eat with Nien unnie,
we had two main dishes and two or three ramens.
We ate all of it.
Food fighter mode.
While eating, we kept saying,
'Isn't this a little lacking?'
'Should we order more~?'
and the order just kept getting bigger.
But here's one warning when ordering Ansungtangmyun with three eggs.
Every time I order it, the lady in the kitchen goes,
'Oh my! Oh my!'
She says that ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
because the eggs keep sticking together. ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
And every time she brings it to me,
she comes over with an awkward smile.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
You know I love Jin Jjambbong.
I tried the three-egg thing with Jin Jjambbong, but it didn't work.
It only suits Ansungtangmyun.
Doesn't it work with spicy classic ramens either?
I think those would still taste okay,

messages.ko: 안성탕면만의 그 특유의 부대찌개 느낌이 있어서
messages.en: but Ansungtangmyun has that unique budae-jjigae vibe,
and that's what makes it delicious.
Jin Ramen Mild is the true ramen though..
I said nothing. ㅎㅎ
You're the worst.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'm getting tired of SpongeBob after watching it for so long.
Isn't there something else to watch?
How about Hello Jadoo next?
I was watching that earlier already.
Ah, I should watch a magical girl anime~
They're so cute~

messages.ko: 나중에 하연이 차 조수석 타는 사람은 안전벨트 세겹으로 메야할듯
messages.en: Anyone riding shotgun in your car someday should wear three seatbelts.
What are you talking about?
They should wear a helmet too.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: Y/n태우면 내가 거북이보다 느리게 안전하게 태워줄게
messages.en: If I drive with Y/n, I'll drive more safely and more slowly than a turtle.
The important thing is that you're riding with me.

messages.ko: 내가 뒤에서 차 미는게 더 빠를수도...?
messages.en: It might be faster if I push the car from behind...?
Hmm... would you do that for me..?
Then imagine you gave me a ride in your car.

messages.ko: 내가 조수석에서 과자 막 개걸스럽게 먹고
messages.en: I'd sit in the passenger seat, aggressively eating snacks,
put my feet up, and just fall asleep.
How does that sound?
I'd secretly leave you behind.
Hmm... where am I?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
That's literally what I do in my dad's car.
Sorry, Dad.
Dad is usually busy singing, though.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 그 소음을 견디고 잠에 드는 내가 대단한거야
messages.en: I'm the amazing one for falling asleep despite all that noise.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 이시간에 엽떡을 먹는것에 대해 어떻게 생각하시나요
messages.en: What are your thoughts on eating Yupdduk at this hour?
Wow, it's already 11.
Just eat it~~
If you don't have a shoot tomorrow, it's totally fine~~
I had bingsu earlier too.
Wow, bingsu.
Fruit!
I should order some~
Even with the AC on, it's still so hot.
I'm sweating.
But once winter comes,
and it's freezing,
I'll probably miss this weather so much.
This summer feels especially long.
It feels like winter is never going to come.
Winter will come.
Yeah!
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Wow, I'm sweating.
I'm going to take a cool shower now,
then order some bingsu.
Sleep well. ㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Haranghae~ ❤️😘
